clock_contract.read_order: At every entry and exit read wall then CPU in that order; record clock implementations/resolution and calibration envelope. Clocks are distinct, not a simultaneous timestamp.
clock_contract.rule: Never add a host timestamp to simulated time. Only a declared duration policy maps host deltas to a simulated delay; do not subtract CPU from wall or clamp CPU/wall to one.
clock_contract.UTC: Optional campaign metadata only; never elapsed timing or authority.
clock_contract.native: Process CPU includes all worker threads. SINGLE must be configured before numerical imports and observed; environment variables alone do not prove it.

accounting.tree_rule: Inclusive duration = end-start. Exclusive duration = inclusive minus complete immediate-child occurrences on the same clock. Aggregate disjoint siblings only; never add preview children, IPOPT internals, gain children or controller total on top of parents.
accounting.reconciliation: Full prepare = sum exclusive leaves/parent residuals. Preserve signed residuals and clock-pair skew; investigate negative residual or uncovered spans. No arbitrary clamping or assumed zero. Approved clock-resolution allowance is unresolved in review_gates.json.
accounting.existing_fields: Preserve every legacy timing field and boundary. planner_total_time/planner_cpu_time end at planner.py:84-85; solve_time on successful solve includes the adapter pre-call entry overhead whereas ipopt_call is just the backend invocation.
accounting.legacy_delta: Use full_prepare duration minus the legacy duration converted from seconds; label float conversion/clock skew. Do not relabel the legacy boundary as full readiness.
accounting.dispatch_envelope: Research observer at existing release boundary before capture/recorder work through completed preparation and sidecar append, immediately before current delay selection. Include enabled capture overhead once. Report whole-worker CPU and later serialization separately.
accounting.metric_population: Recurring launch cohort [t0,t1): charge every fully observed launched call including failed/rejected/late/terminal physically pending calls. Missing host completion means partial/lower-bound CPU and incomplete aggregate, never imputation. Startup/construction separate.
accounting.offline_panel: CPU/wall per call only; no physical simulated-duration denominator.

record_fields.causal_rule: Unavailable future outcome is null with reason until observed outside the preparation kernel; immutable causal inputs never receive actual future completion or state.
record_fields.safety_rule: application_permission_status is not_implemented_or_unobserved for frozen A, not inferred true from applied commands. Existing simulated applications remain observations, not S0 grants.

readiness_policy.current_consumer: AsyncRunner.run.release: asynchronous.py:246-254 consumes legacy planner_total_time under measured dispatch; controlled DiagnosticTiming overrides via its existing interface.
readiness_policy.phase_A: Do not redirect this consumer or mutate packets with new full timers. Controlled zero/injected parity uses identical approved delays. Report legacy completion, observed host full duration, dispatch envelope and would-be full-boundary readiness separately; the latter is an audit, never authority.
readiness_policy.phase_B_blocker: Engineering must explicitly settle whether availability is reported on legacy A timing or an independently versioned full-boundary policy. Full-preparation authority claims require charging the declared full envelope, including observer cost, through a separately reviewed mapping; silently omitting it or silently changing A scheduling is prohibited.
readiness_policy.measured_parity: Wall equality and measured closed-loop trace equality are not required; genuine readiness changes are reported as observer effects, never removed or mislabeled numerical changes.
